bullets.text: Land mine casualties in Syria have significantly increased two years after the war, with nearly 1,000 children among those killed or injured by leftover explosives.
An Israeli air strike in Gaza has reportedly killed Naeem Abu Nahel, Hamas's internal security chief, along with six other Palestinians.
The Nato chief has pledged to defend against space threats following reports that Russia plans to launch a satellite with a nuclear warhead.
A data breach in the National Parks booking system has led to a surge of 4WDs on a critical turtle nesting beach in Queensland, causing concern for wildlife.
Older Australians are expressing frustration over reassessments for the Support at Home program, with an interim inquiry report expected in parliament this week.
A bipartisan parliamentary committee has recommended reversing changes made in 2021 that limited the powers of South Australia's anti-corruption watchdog.
The Nasdaq 100 Index experienced a significant drop, driven by a decline in chipmakers, as investor enthusiasm for AI-related technology stocks waned amid broader market concerns.

The Canadian dollar saw its largest gain in over three months after the Bank of Canada warned that rising oil costs are expected to further increase consumer prices, exacerbating existing inflationary pressures.
Former President Trump is preparing to implement new tariffs on major economies, including China, the EU, Japan, and South Korea, signaling a renewed focus on his protectionist trade strategy.
